title: Engagement, User Satisfaction, and the Amplification of Divisive Content on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Algorithmic audit comparing Twitter's engagement-based timeline to a reverse-chronological baseline by scraping user feeds and using user surveys (alongside GPT-4) to evaluate the ideological leaning and partisanship of the curated tweets.

Surveying users to assess the presence of out-group animosity in curated tweets and measuring how algorithmically selected content alters readers' perceptions of their political in-group versus out-group.
